'''FC Felcsút''' is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] football team based in the village of [[Felcsút]].<ref>{{Citation|last=Viktor Orbán|title=OVTV Extra: Játszik az F.C. Felcsút|date=2010-01-26|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JvKQ8lO9L_M|access-date=2019-06-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://theorangefiles.hu/2013/08/08/one-mans-plaything/|title=One Man’s Plaything|last=Files|first=Orange|date=2013-08-08|website=The Orange Files|language=en|access-date=2019-06-25}}</ref> They play in the league [[NB II]] of the Western Group.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/news/2018/jan/11/viktor-orban-hungary-prime-minister-reckless-football-obsession|title=Viktor Orbán’s reckless football obsession|last=Nolan|first=Daniel|date=2018-01-11|work=The Guardian|access-date=2019-06-25|last2=Goldblatt|first2=David|language=en-GB|issn=0261-3077}}</ref>"}}
